bio: I am an immigrant from Jordan who grew up in the Midwest. In 2020, I graduated from Johns Hopkins University with a Bachelors of Arts with Honors in Writing Seminars and a minor in Islamic Studies. In addition, I was award a National Fellowship to research ovarian cancer at the National Institutes of Health. Now, I am a medical student at Harvard.
